purpose: Post-hoc exploratory search for economic loss control by reducing only the affected LSEG company's weight rather than the whole 33-stock basket.
claim_boundary: This is an exploratory dissertation robustness analysis because LSEG returns have already been opened elsewhere.
All candidates, development selection rules, the forward boundary and the evaluation family are fixed here before running Notebook 82.
A positive result can support an LSEG economic-value case but cannot be described as preregistered confirmation.
The 33-company LSEG cohort is a fixed selected large-cap sample and does not identify a population-wide causal effect.

population.return: raw split-adjusted open-to-next-common-open price return; dividends excluded
population.signal_timing: Reuters stories assigned to the firm-open using the existing causal availability rule

portfolio.base: daily equal-weight long portfolio of the same 33 companies
portfolio.overlay: multiply each company's 1/33 base weight by its own news-risk modifier and leave the residual in cash
matched_controls: development symbol-matched fixed weights: each symbol keeps its development-average candidate weight on every evaluation day

development_selection.primary_metric: worst-fold annual downside-utility difference versus the development symbol-matched fixed-weight control, gamma=5
secondary_metrics: mean fold utility difference versus symbol-matched fixed weights
mean fold expected-shortfall reduction versus symbol-matched fixed weights
eligibility: utility difference versus symbol-matched control is positive in at least two of three chronological development folds
expected-shortfall reduction versus symbol-matched control is positive in at least two of three folds
evaluation mean gross exposure is not used in selection
development_selection.no_eligible_candidate_rule: stop and report no robust development candidate; do not relax the eligibility rule

evaluation_family.method: paired moving-block bootstrap, block length 20 sessions, 9999 replications
comparisons: selected overlay versus development symbol-matched fixed weights
selected overlay versus development aggregate-exposure-matched equal weights

required_against_symbol_matched_control: BH-adjusted q < 0.05 for downside utility or one tail-risk estimand
mean net-return difference lower 95% bound greater than -1 basis point per session
positive compounded ending-wealth difference at 2 bps per side
stability: positive net economic difference in both evaluation halves
